name: opencode-lib-context
body:
The shared plumbing's opencode 2.x context adaptation: `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts`'s `ToolContext` sources the project location from the plugin context (`ctx.location.directory`, `ctx.location.project`) in place of the V1 `{ directory, worktree }` tool context, and keeps the tool's own optional `directory` argument authoritative for the project-root walk-up (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.findApgRoot`) and the stored-identity rebasing (`requirements.requirement.absolute-paths-at-tool-boundary`). The acting agent's edit-scope readers (`ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.readAgentEditGlobs`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.editAllowGlobs`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.agentFsGlobs`) source the scope through the opencode 2.x agent/permission surface; the pure `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.fsScopeDecision` boundary+ordered-match semantics are unchanged, pinned by the plugin-free unit test.

implemented-by: `opencode-suite/lib/apg.ts`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.ToolContext`, `ts.apg-opencode-suite.lib.apg.readAgentEditGlobs`, `opencode-suite/lib/apg.test.ts`.
